instructions.name: deposit
docs: remaining_accounts: for each held mint in `vault.held` order, `[mint, vault_token_account]`.

instructions.name: rebalance
docs: remaining_accounts: first `[mint, vault_token_account]` for every held mint in `vault.held`
order, then exactly the accounts the router instruction expects, in its order.

accounts.name: keeper
docs: The registry's keeper. Pays the transaction and any new token account, and is paid back a
flat fee from the vault's gas tank.

instructions.name: redeem
docs: remaining_accounts: for each held mint in `vault.held` order,
`[mint, vault_token_account, recipient_token_account]`.

instructions.name: set_strategy
docs: Plan text and target weights. Only before activation.

errors.name: NotAdmin
errors.msg: Only the registry admin can do this

errors.name: NotGuardian
errors.msg: Only the guardian can do this

errors.name: NotManager
errors.msg: Only the vault manager can do this

errors.name: WrongState
errors.msg: The vault is not in the right state for this

errors.name: BelowMinimumSeed
errors.msg: Seed is below the 10 USDC minimum

errors.name: InvalidName
errors.msg: Name must be 1-32 bytes

errors.name: InvalidPlanLength
errors.msg: Plan must be 1-1000 bytes

errors.name: NoPlanPosted
errors.msg: Post a plan before the first trade

errors.name: MissingPrice
errors.msg: A held asset has no signed price

errors.name: ZeroPrice
errors.msg: A signed price is zero

errors.name: StalePrices
errors.msg: Signed prices are older than 60 seconds or in the future

errors.name: LengthMismatch
errors.msg: Price lists differ in length

errors.name: InvalidPriceSignature
errors.msg: The price signature is missing or not from the price signer

errors.name: EmptyVault
errors.msg: The vault holds nothing

errors.name: ZeroShares
errors.msg: Deposit buys zero shares

errors.name: SlippageTooHigh
errors.msg: Fewer shares than the minimum asked for

errors.name: NothingToRedeem
errors.msg: Nothing to redeem

errors.name: InsufficientShares
errors.msg: Not enough shares

errors.name: HeldAccountsMismatch
errors.msg: The accounts passed do not match the vault's held assets

errors.name: WrongVaultTokenAccount
errors.msg: This token account is not the vault's account for that mint

errors.name: WrongRecipientAccount
errors.msg: Recipient token account has the wrong mint

errors.name: RouterNotAllowed
errors.msg: Swap program is not allowlisted

errors.name: AssetNotAllowed
errors.msg: Asset is not allowlisted

errors.name: AssetNotHeld
errors.msg: The vault does not hold the asset it is selling

errors.name: SellExceeded
errors.msg: The trade sold more than allowed

errors.name: BuyTooLow
errors.msg: The trade bought less than the minimum

errors.name: TradeLossTooHigh
errors.msg: The trade lost more than 2% against the signed prices

errors.name: CollateralDecreased
errors.msg: A vault balance went down that should not have

errors.name: AuthorityChanged
errors.msg: A vault token account gained a delegate, close authority or new owner

errors.name: TooManyAssets
errors.msg: A vault may hold at most 10 assets

errors.name: ListFull
errors.msg: Too many allowlisted entries

errors.name: Overflow
errors.msg: Math overflow

errors.name: NotKeeper
errors.msg: Only the keeper can do this

errors.name: InvalidTargets
errors.msg: Targets must be allowlisted, distinct, above zero and sum to 100%

errors.name: StrategyLocked
errors.msg: The strategy can only change through a passed proposal once the vault is active

errors.name: GasTankEmpty
errors.msg: The vault's gas tank cannot pay the keeper

errors.name: RebalanceTooSoon
errors.msg: A rebalance cycle already ran in the last 12 hours

errors.name: SellNotOverweight
errors.msg: The asset sold is not above its target weight

errors.name: BuyNotUnderweight
errors.msg: The asset bought is not below its target weight

errors.name: TargetOvershoot
errors.msg: The trade overshoots a target weight

errors.name: InvalidVotingPeriod
errors.msg: Voting period must be 1-14 days

errors.name: BondTooSmall
errors.msg: The proposal bond is below the minimum

errors.name: ProposalAlreadyOpen
errors.msg: This vault already has a proposal in voting or timelock

errors.name: VotingClosed
errors.msg: Voting on this proposal is closed

errors.name: VotingStillOpen
errors.msg: Voting is still open

errors.name: NoVotingPower
errors.msg: No shares to vote with on this proposal

errors.name: WrongProposalStatus
errors.msg: The proposal is not in the right status for this

errors.name: TimelockActive
errors.msg: The timelock has not ended

errors.name: WrongProposer
errors.msg: That account is not the proposer

types.name: Position
docs: One investor's shares in one vault. Not a token, so shares cannot be transferred.

fields.name: snapshot_proposal
docs: `id + 1` of the open proposal for which `snapshot_shares` was recorded, or 0.

fields.name: snapshot_shares
docs: Shares held just before the first deposit made while that proposal was open.

types.name: PriceUpdate
docs: `prices[i]` = settlement base units for ONE WHOLE `mints[i]` token.

types.name: Proposal
docs: A curator's request to change the vault's target weights and plan.

fields.name: timelock_ends_at
docs: Set when the proposal passes.

fields.name: total_shares
docs: Vault share supply when proposed; quorum is measured against it.

fields.name: bond
docs: Lamports held on this account (above rent) as the curator's bond.

fields.name: admin
docs: Governance. Changes allowlists, guardian and price signer.

fields.name: guardian
docs: Can activate, pause and unpause vaults without a delay.

fields.name: price_signer
docs: ed25519 key the backend signs prices with.

fields.name: settlement_mint
docs: The stablecoin every vault is seeded and subscribed in. Fixed at init.

fields.name: keeper
docs: The automation key allowed to run target-weight rebalances. Defaults to the guardian.

types.name: Target
docs: One target weight: `bps` of vault value should sit in `mint`.

fields.name: total_shares
docs: All shares in existence, DEAD_SHARES included.

fields.name: plan
docs: The manager's investment plan, free text. Informational only.

fields.name: plan_version
docs: Bumped by every `set_plan`; 0 means no plan yet.

fields.name: held
docs: Mints the vault holds. USDC is always first and never leaves.

fields.name: targets
docs: Target weights, summing to 100%. Set once before activation; afterwards only a passed
proposal changes them.

fields.name: gas_tank
docs: Lamports held on this account (above rent) that pay the keeper for rebalances.

fields.name: cycle_start
docs: Start of the current rebalance cycle (unix seconds); 0 means a new cycle may start now.

fields.name: proposal_count
docs: Proposals ever made; the next proposal's id.

fields.name: open_proposal
docs: `id + 1` of the proposal in voting or timelock, or 0 if none.

types.name: VoteRecord
docs: One holder's vote on one proposal. Its existence prevents voting twice.
